goal: To design and build a modern, professional, and technically credible flooring and concrete-coatings web presence for MGT Pro Services.
deliverables: Newly redesigned web site for mgtproservices.com
The features listed below apply to the web site - mgtproservices.com

description: Storage of scalable content and images in Contentful Content Management System
Hosting, Domain, and Template usage costs for Blog on WordPress platform
Meta tags - title, description, keywords, and Open Graph tags for social media sharing
Foundational files - sitemap.xml, sitemap.json, rss.xml, robots.txt, not-found.html, manifest.webmanifest, humans.txt, security.txt, well-known.txt, Loading page, Global Errors page, Style Guide page
Rich Schemas for AI - Blog Posting, Breadcrumbs, FAQs, LocalBusiness, Podcast (if used), Product, Recipe, Review, Services, Website
Additional files for AI - llms.txt, ai.txt
Hosting via Amazon Web Services (AWS).  Services include AWS Amplify, AWS CloudFront CDN, AWS Route 53 DNS including SSL Certificate, AWS CloudWatch Logging
Distribution of images in Cloudinary Content Delivery System
Google Business, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, LinkedIn, Nextdoor
Links of new / existing social media accounts added to the web site

milestones.milestone: Site Launch and New Social Media accounts created - mgtproservices.com

description: Initial base pricing for the MGT Services website build is $3000.
Initial build includes the website structure, design, content management setup, SEO foundational files, hosting configuration, and creation of new social media accounts.

paymentScheduleDetails: Full and final payment of $2500 due upon completion of the website build, social media accounts creation, and web site launch.
